node.label: lysosomal lipid storage disorder
node.definition: An inherited metabolic disorder in which harmful amounts of lipids accumulate in cells and tissues. Because of a functionally impaired hydrolase or auxiliary protein, their lipid substrates cannot be degraded, accumulate in the lysosome, and slowly spread to other intracellular membranes.
synonyms: rare inborn error of lipid storage

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)
